expected._comment: v7.38.25 -- measured at last. This fixture opened with loose budgets (cold 200 / warm 100 / p95 150) and a README that said they were 'pending real measurement'; the measurement is three runs on an idle testbed, five re-extracted cold samples each: cold medians 0.88 / 1.11 / 0.87 ms (individual samples 0.82-1.54), p50 0.50 / 0.48 / 0.48, p95 0.60 / 0.55 / 0.58. The old numbers were 200x-250x the measurement, which is the 'set five times too high catches nothing' failure c81f818b named, at forty times that. These are 3-5x instead: the x1.5 rule the suite budgets use does not carry down to sub-millisecond quantities, because scheduling jitter is absolute rather than relative -- 1.5x of 0.88 ms is 1.3 ms and the samples already reach 1.54. For scale, the mailrs report's PG18 baseline for this shape is ~100 ms cold, so 5 ms still leaves twenty times of it.
